Manufacturing deserves better

We’re building the tools that help NASA, Tesla, Rivian and hundreds of top teams bring the future to life. Can you help us make it even better?

Watch video

Trusted by the world's top-tier companies

The trusted backbone of manufacturing

See open roles

The future is physical. Rockets, drones, AI data centers, surgical robots. All of it runs on custom parts someone has to actually manufacture, and that’s exactly where things break.

Custom manufacturing is the bottleneck in hardware, and a world racing toward local manufacturing is only making the problem more accute.

Jiga fixes that. We’re building the trusted backbone for how the world’s most important parts get made.

We work differently

Most companies talk about transparency and trust. We actually do it.

01

We share the numbers

As a team member, you’ll see the full picture: revenue, valuation, runway, roadmap, sales pipeline, what’s working and what fails.

02

We have been remote and async

From day one and we love it. But we also love our team: once a year we bring everyone together to a small offsite in paradise for co-working, hiking, eating, drinking and sailing.

03

We don’t count hours, we track performance

You are senior enough to know what it means, we don’t need to explain.

04

We don’t do busy-work

We meet for a weekly all-hands and a team sync. That’s it. Everything else is async. Your calendar will be empty to write code, talk to customers or to fix problems.

05

We deliver 11/10 customer experience.

We don’t settle for “good enough.” Quick response times, going the extra mile, creating fans not just users. It’s part of our DNA.

06

We decide fast

The person closest to the problem makes the call. No approval chains, no review committees and no endless layers of management.

07

Profitability is freedom

We are cashflow positive, growing revenue by 3x YoY. No desperate fundraising, no panic pivots, no mass layoffs. The magic we’re building is being built to last for long time.

08

“Don’t drink the Kool-Aid”

is our motto. If you see something that needs fixing, it’s your duty to raise a flag or just fix it yourself.

09

We hire the best people

We’ve gathered a super group of the best talents in engineering, supply chain and sales. Everyone knows what they need to do and cruising through it.

10

Ship now, iterate later

Perfection is the enemy of done. We’d rather learn from something that is live on production, than debate something theoretical.
